contracts: (A fresh replay, after reconstructing the pinned identities, has machine-verifiable diagnostic categories exactly equal to the pinned semantic result.) AND (Any unexplained mismatch in a result-determining snapshot member prevents semantic reproduction and yields stale or another fail-closed terminal status.) AND (Each produced replay result has a complete Current Snapshot association covering every result-determining input, and partial or missing bindings cannot produce success.) AND (Fresh replay first rebuilds the original binding identity, replays with that same identity, and rejects an identity mismatch or omitted, stale, copied, or unattributed evidence binding.) AND (S41 测试确认任一必需执行缺失均使聚合失败。) AND (S41 测试确认该对抗性目标结果为非成功。) AND (S41 测试经真实调用面完成完整序列后确认 Route identity、verdict 和 diagnostics 分别等于其前序 identity 和基线。) AND (The S10 selector accepts a successful Replay Result only when a distinct independent Probe-verification binding is present.) AND (The S10 selector reproduces the recorded result from a fresh checkout using the complete bound Current Snapshot, while unexplained drift is stale or fail closed.) AND (The S16 selector proves every listed invalid identity or execution-fact condition prevents success.) AND (The S41 selector proves unexplained result-determining input drift cannot leave a replay result accepted as current.) AND (The S41 selector verifies both subject executions in all six Matrix Cases and rejects any missing execution.) AND (The evidence selector verifies an auditable historical validator reference and fails if the reference is absent or unverifiable.) AND (聚合 verdict 为 invalid 且 acceptance gate 被阻断；若仍 valid 或通过 acceptance 则失败。) AND (验证器确认六个 Matrix Case 均有执行记录、输入身份两两不同且绑定两个 subjects；否则返回失败。)
selector_intents: Execute the authored S10 selector against a clean checkout and bound Current Snapshot; it fails until replay reproduction is implemented.
Execute the fresh-replay selector with a changed target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, or evidence binding.
Execute the successful-replay selector with the independent Probe verification binding omitted, substituted, or self-reported and require it to fail.
Mutate one result-determining snapshot member and require the reconstruction check to reject any non-stale reproduction result.
Produce a replay result with a missing, partial, or unbound Current Snapshot and require fail-closed evaluation.
Replay a pinned semantic result with a diagnostic-category mismatch and require semantic reproduction to fail.
Run the S16 pytest selector with invalid identity and execution facts; any success result demonstrates a semantic success-gate gap.
Run the S41 matrix test with one Matrix Case missing either Stable or Candidate execution; aggregate validation must fail.
Run the S41 pytest selector with unexplained result-determining input drift; the unimplemented replay path must fail to produce the required stale or fail-closed observation.
Run the historical-evidence selector against evidence lacking a validator reference or containing an unverifiable reference and require integrity validation failure.
向矩阵执行验证提供缺失一个 case 执行或复用另一 case 输入的 SM-3 对抗样例，断言验证器拒绝该执行集合。
将对抗性目标错误评为成功；S41 断言应失败。
执行完整生命周期序列且使 identity、verdict 或 diagnostics 偏离前序基线；观察运行时失败标记。
提供未执行矩阵证据的聚合输入并执行聚合验证；若 verdict 仍为 valid 或 acceptance 通过，则负向断言失败。
省略一个必需 Matrix Case 输入或主体执行；观察聚合失败标记。
